verdict.rationale: PayPal exposes a versioned cart API (v1 createcart/getcart), a sandbox test environment, and catalog feed validation ('validated product catalog file... ready to connect'), which gives some conformance/testing surface; it also follows external protocol specs (ACP, UCP) rather than only its own. But there is no evidence of a published formal schema (e.g., OpenAPI/JSON Schema) for the agentic-commerce API or a dedicated conformance/validation test suite for developers to certify implementations against. Missing for 10: published machine-readable schema/spec for the cart API, an explicit conformance/validation tool or test suite beyond catalog feed checks, and clear protocol versioning semantics beyond the 'v1' path segment.
